name: us_states

frame.formula: x = (px - cx) * s, z = (py - cy) * s  (us-atlas Albers USA pixels, y down = south = +Z)

source: US Census Bureau cartographic boundary files (public domain) via us-atlas 3.0.1 counties-albers-10m (https://github.com/topojson/us-atlas), Albers USA pixels, contiguous 48 states + DC
orientation: rings not closed; outer rings counter-clockwise seen from +Y with north (-Z) up, i.e. positive shoelace area in (x, -z); holes clockwise
notes: Contiguous 48 states + DC; Alaska and Hawaii dropped (Albers USA insets).

Census cartographic (shoreline-clipped) boundaries: borders through the Great Lakes are not land borders, so e.g. Michigan-Illinois and Michigan-Minnesota are not edges; Michigan-Wisconsin is (Upper Peninsula).
Adjacency = shared TopoJSON arc of non-zero length; Four Corners style point contacts are in 'points', not edges.
